clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Requirements of resin type chemical resistant mortars for bonding chemical resistant masonry units. Such mortars have good resistance to non-oxidizing mineral acid and poor resistance to oxidizing mineral acid. Fairly resistant to inorganic alkalis. Resistant to water; hence give impermeable joints. Used for joining acid-proof bricks and tiles.

clauses.title: Fillers
clauses.text: 2.2 Fillers— Siliceous or other inert fillers. Shall be graded so as to permit 1.5 mm joints.

clauses.title: Catalyst
clauses.text: 2.3 Catalyst —  May  be  incorporated in fillers

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 4. General Requirements  — Resin shall have viscosity. Filler material shall have properly graded particles that will permit preparation of a minimum joint thickness of 1.5 mm.

clauses.title: Chemical Resistance
clauses.text: 5. Chemical Resistance  Requirement — The limits may be settled between the purchaser and supplier.

clauses.title: Shelf Life
clauses.text: 6. Shelf Life — For phenolic and polyster resins is about 3 months and for furance and epoxy resins about 12 months from date of manufacture.
